# Vendored Lucide for BobloUI

This directory pins the Roblox atlas generated by
`mstudio45/lucide-roblox-direct` at commit
`e8b0019ebd7e18c455bbbd720ed7b610bc6675f7` (2026-08-03).

- `source.lua` is the upstream standalone Roblox mapping retained for audit.
- `spritesheets/1.png` and `spritesheets/2.png` are the two source atlases.
- `LUCIDE-LICENSE` covers Lucide and the Feather-derived icons.
- `ROBLOX-PORT-LICENSE` covers the Roblox atlas implementation.

BobloUI bundles a normalized mapping in `src/primitives/Lucide.lua`. It does
not execute the downloader contained in the upstream `source.lua`. The build
copies both PNG files to `dist/assets/bobloui/` so they can be committed beside
`BobloUI.lua` in the BobloScript GitHub repository.

Roblox `ImageLabel` instances cannot use a GitHub raw PNG URL directly. The
runtime therefore downloads only these pinned image bytes, validates their PNG
signature, byte length and dimensions, caches them locally, and registers them
through an executor custom-asset API. No Roblox asset ID is used. Environments
without the required executor capabilities use BobloUI's asset-free GuiObject
fallback icons.
